description: This Java class manages the UI and logic for displaying and handling user interactions with apps that have known vulnerabilities, prompting for actions like upgrade or uninstall.

classes.name: KnownVulnAppListItemController
classes.description: Controller class for managing UI and actions related to apps with known vulnerabilities, allowing users to upgrade or uninstall.

methods.name: KnownVulnAppListItemController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with activity context, refresh callback, and view.

methods.name: getCurrentViewState
methods.description: Returns the current UI state based on whether the app should be upgraded or uninstalled.

methods.name: shouldUpgradeInsteadOfUninstall
methods.description: Determines if the app should be upgraded instead of uninstalled based on version codes.

methods.name: onActionButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles user action to upgrade or uninstall the app, registering broadcast receivers accordingly.

methods.name: canDismiss
methods.description: Indicates whether the UI element can be dismissed; returns false.

methods.name: unregisterInstallReceiver
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver for install/uninstall actions.

methods.name: refreshUpdatesList
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the app list to reflect current vulnerabilities.
